name: KPV
description: Three-amino-acid peptide (Lys-Pro-Val), the last three amino acids of the hormone alpha-MSH

note.text: FDA's 2026 review found no clinical studies, no human pharmacokinetic data and no case reports for any route.

bullets: **Not through melanocortin receptors,** unlike alpha-MSH, in lab and mouse tests
**Blocked NF-kappaB** and inflammatory signals in human gut and immune cells (lab)
**Enters gut cells** through the PepT1 transporter (lab)
**In people,** the mechanism is not established
Mouse, rabbit and cell studies only
No human studies or case reports (FDA)

practical.pharmacokinetics: No human data; did not pass intact human skin (lab)
practical.sport: Not named on the 2026 list; S0 status unconfirmed

regulatory.text: Not named; class S0 may apply

references: FDA, Pharmacy Compounding Advisory Committee briefing on KPV, July 2026
